registers.name: CONTROL_STATUS
registers.description: Primary control and live status register. Software uses this register to program enable/start/abort/clear-fault semantics and to read back busy/fault/fallback and one-shot status indicators.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Master enable. When deasserted, software disable forces safe fallback behavior and blocks new request launch.

fields.name: START_REQUEST
fields.description: Write-one pulse or level-qualified start trigger. When asserted while ENABLE is set and no transaction is outstanding, it launches a new request.

fields.name: ABORT
fields.description: Write-one abort request. Cancels pending request context, deasserts tx_valid, returns the FSM to IDLE, and enters safe fallback.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULT
fields.description: Write-one sticky fault clear request. Clear is honored only when allowed by the safety FSM policy, typically when no outstanding transaction remains or after explicit abort completion.

fields.name: SLEW_LIMIT_EN
fields.description: Enables optional slew limiting in the actuator command limiter.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Busy indication. High while a request is outstanding or while awaiting actuator acceptance.

fields.name: FAULT
fields.description: Sticky fault indication. High after timeout, invalid response, software disable policy violation, or abort-related safety fault until cleared by software under allowed conditions.

fields.name: FALLBACK
fields.description: Fallback indication. High whenever the safe fallback command is active due to timeout, invalid response, software disable, abort, or safety fault.

fields.name: REQUEST_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: Indicates that a single request is currently outstanding in the transport adapter.

fields.name: LAST_RESPONSE_OK
fields.description: Indicates whether the most recently observed response was accepted by the validator.

fields.name: COMMAND_APPLIED
fields.description: Indicates the safety FSM observed command application/acceptance on the actuator path.

fields.name: STATE_ID_IDLE
fields.description: One-hot or equivalent state observation for IDLE.

fields.name: STATE_ID_ISSUE_REQUEST
fields.description: One-hot or equivalent state observation for ISSUE_REQUEST.

fields.name: STATE_ID_WAIT_RESPONSE
fields.description: One-hot or equivalent state observation for WAIT_RESPONSE.

fields.name: STATE_ID_VALIDATE_RESPONSE
fields.description: One-hot or equivalent state observation for VALIDATE_RESPONSE.

fields.name: STATE_ID_APPLY_COMMAND
fields.description: One-hot or equivalent state observation for APPLY_COMMAND.

fields.name: STATE_ID_FALLBACK
fields.description: One-hot or equivalent state observation for FALLBACK.

fields.name: STATE_ID_ABORT
fields.description: One-hot or equivalent state observation for ABORT.

registers.name: MODEL_AND_SEQUENCE
registers.description: Model selection and sequence programming register.

fields.name: MODEL_ID
fields.description: External runtime model identifier used in request frame assembly.

fields.name: REQUEST_SEQ
fields.description: Software-programmed request sequence number for the outbound request frame.

fields.name: EXPECTED_RESPONSE_SEQ
fields.description: Expected response sequence number used by the validator.

fields.name: REQUEST_FLAGS
fields.description: Compact request flags and integrity/behavior metadata for the outbound frame.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
fields.description: Programmable timeout deadline in cycles.

fields.name: MAX_RESPONSE_AGE
fields.description: Maximum accepted response age threshold.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved for alignment and future extension.

registers.name: COMMAND_LIMITS
registers.description: Clamp and safe fallback command programming.

fields.name: CLAMP_MIN
fields.description: Minimum allowed actuator command after clamping.

fields.name: CLAMP_MAX
fields.description: Maximum allowed actuator command after clamping.

registers.name: SAFE_FALLBACK_AND_SLEW
registers.description: Safe fallback command and optional slew-limit step configuration.

fields.name: SAFE_FALLBACK_CMD
fields.description: Command used when fallback is active or when reset requires a safe default.

fields.name: SLEW_LIMIT_STEP
fields.description: Maximum allowed step between successive commands when slew limiting is enabled.

registers.name: REQUEST_DESCRIPTOR_LO
registers.description: Low 64 bits of the compact request descriptor window. This is metadata only and does not store bulk geometry payloads.

fields.name: DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE_LO
fields.description: Low half of a descriptor handle or pointer-style token referencing external data owned by the runtime.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_LENGTH
fields.description: Compact geometry length or descriptor length in bytes or units defined by software protocol.

fields.name: REQUEST_TYPE
fields.description: Request type encoding for the external runtime.

fields.name: INTEGRITY_BITS
fields.description: Optional integrity metadata such as parity, CRC seed, or protocol flags.

registers.name: REQUEST_DESCRIPTOR_HI
registers.description: High 64 bits of the compact request descriptor window. This remains metadata-only and bounded.

fields.name: DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE_HI
fields.description: High half of the descriptor handle or pointer-style token.

fields.name: FLOW_COND_0
fields.description: First compact flow-condition scalar.

fields.name: FLOW_COND_1
fields.description: Second compact flow-condition scalar.

registers.name: STATUS_SUMMARY
registers.description: Aggregated status readback register for software polling.

fields.name: LAST_ERROR_CODE
fields.description: Sticky or last error code from timeout, mismatch, invalid response, abort, or policy violation.

fields.name: LAST_RESPONSE_OK
fields.description: Indicates the last response was accepted.

fields.name: REQUEST_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: Single outstanding transaction indicator.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Busy indicator.

fields.name: FAULT
fields.description: Sticky fault indicator.

fields.name: FALLBACK
fields.description: Fallback-active indicator.

fields.name: LAST_SEQ
fields.description: Last accepted sequence number.

fields.name: LAST_ACT_CMD
fields.description: Last actuator command presented to the command path.

registers.name: INTERRUPT_STATUS
registers.description: Interrupt-style event summary. The design does not require a dedicated interrupt pin; this register supports polling-based software completion handling.

fields.name: REQ_ISSUED_EVT
fields.description: Request issued handshake event.

fields.name: RESP_ACCEPTED_EVT
fields.description: Response accepted event.

fields.name: RESP_REJECTED_EVT
fields.description: Response rejected event.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_EVT
fields.description: Timeout event.

fields.name: ABORT_EVT
fields.description: Abort event.

fields.name: FAULT_LATCHED_EVT
fields.description: Fault latched event.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.
